report.explanation: Current telemetry does not support the operator's deployment hypothesis. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and DB spans returning 200/ok. Order metrics show only version 1.0.0 serving /v1/orders with 200s and zero 502s; version 2.0.0 has no traffic. The deployment record shows only baseline order v1.0.0 with no previous version, so it cannot establish deployment-caused errors. No checkout error evidence exists; hand off.
missing_evidence: Error-bearing telemetry (non-2xx/5xx spans or logs) for checkout, order, or payment during the incident window
Deployment records for all services with version transitions and timestamps preceding the incident
Logs for order and gateway (excluded from context) to confirm or refute checkout errors
Metric series showing error rates or latency degradation correlated with any deployment
